preconditions.description: Attacker must have sufficient balance of the input token for the swap
A pending transaction must exist in the mempool that will affect the pool reserves (e.g., a large swap or liquidity addition)

exploit_hint: Monitor the mempool for pending transactions that will move the price in a Uniswap pair. Front-run the victim's swap transaction by submitting your own swap with higher gas price to execute first, then back-run with another swap after the victim's transaction executes. Use swapExactTokensForTokens or swapExactETHForTokens functions to profit from the price movement.
